subject: Mental Models
title: MECE Framework
description: A fast breakdown of MECE Framework for builders.

hook.text: McKinsey consultants split every problem using one rule: mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive.

buildup.text: MECE means every piece of the problem belongs in exactly one bucket, and all buckets together cover the entire problem.

discovery.text: Without MECE, you double-count some factors and miss others. The analysis looks thorough but has hidden holes.

twist.text: Perfect MECE is often impossible in messy reality. Aim for close enough. Even imperfect MECE beats no structure.

climax.text: Split your next big decision into MECE categories.

punchline.text: No overlaps, no gaps. Clean structure makes clean thinking.
